name: triptych
description: A modular three-ESP32 computer with Z80-compatible CPU, video, and sound contracts

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.proof:cpm-host-parity: npm run build:wasm-host && cargo build --locked -p triptych-host-native && node tools/prove-cpm-host-parity.mjs
scripts.proof:cpm-large: npm run build:wasm-host && cargo build --locked -p triptych-host-native && node tools/prove-large-disk.mjs && node tools/prove-large-apps.mjs && node tools/prove-large-drive-isolation.mjs && node tools/prove-large-ab.mjs && node tools/prove-large-ab-limits.mjs
scripts.check:cpm-large: npm run check:large-ab-fixture && npm run build:wasm-host && cargo build --locked -p triptych-host-native && node tools/prove-large-disk.mjs --allow-dirty && node tools/prove-large-apps.mjs --allow-dirty && node tools/prove-large-drive-isolation.mjs && node tools/prove-large-ab.mjs --allow-dirty && node tools/prove-large-ab-limits.mjs --allow-dirty && npm run check:cpm-large-arenas && npm run check:native-terminal-ab
scripts.check:cpm-large-arenas: node tools/prove-large-ab-limits.mjs --allow-dirty --suite=atom-symbols && node tools/prove-large-ab-limits.mjs --allow-dirty --suite=atom-parts && node tools/prove-large-ab-limits.mjs --allow-dirty --suite=atom-chain && node tools/prove-large-ab-limits.mjs --allow-dirty --suite=nucleus && node tools/prove-large-ab-limits.mjs --allow-dirty --suite=edit
scripts.proof:nucleus-adventure: npm run build:wasm-host && cargo build --locked -p triptych-host-native && node tools/prove-nucleus-adventure.mjs
scripts.check:wasm-browser-ui: node --check crates/triptych-host-wasm/web/app.js && node --check crates/triptych-host-wasm/web/terminal.js && node --check tools/build-wasm-host.mjs && node --check tools/serve-wasm-browser.mjs && node tools/check-wasm-browser-ui.mjs && node --test test/wasm/committed-cache.node.mjs test/wasm/disk-workspace.node.mjs test/wasm/saved-machine-workspace.node.mjs test/wasm/drive-set.node.mjs test/wasm/tool-catalog.node.mjs test/wasm/source-bundle.node.mjs tools/lib/large-disk-system.test.mjs tools/lib/large-ab-system.test.mjs
scripts.check:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --all-features && cargo build -p triptych-host-wasm --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release
scripts.proof:cpm-image-native: cargo build -p triptych-cpm-cli -p triptych-host-native && node tools/prove-cpm-image-native.mjs
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run check:ccp-readiness && npm test && npm run check:cpu-fixtures && npm run check:bdos-baseline && npm run check:ccp-matrix && npm run check:ccp-failures && npm run check:ccp-parser && npm run check:ccp-stack && npm run check:cpm22-text && npm run check:cpm-headless && npm run check:cpm-distribution && npm run check:saved-machine-codecs && npm run check:wasm-browser-ui && npm run test:wasm-browser && npm run proof:native-terminal && npm run check:cpm-host-parity && npm run check:cpm-large && npm run check:nucleus-adventure && npm run check:rust
